subtitleNullable: OOF and test probabilities, StratifiedKFold(5, seed 42), CV AUC 0.96067
descriptionNullable:
## What this is

Out-of-fold and test predictions of a single CatBoost model for [Playground Series S6E10](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/playground-series-s6e10) (airline passenger satisfaction, metric ROC AUC). They are meant to be dropped straight into a stack or blend.

Source notebook: [S6E10 | CatBoost all-cat + original | CV 0.9607](https://www.kaggle.com/code/dmitriykolmikov/s6e10-catboost-all-cat-original-cv-0-9607)

## Model

- Every raw column, including Age and Flight Distance, is passed to CatBoost as a categorical feature, so it builds ordered target statistics per value.
- Numeric copies of the four continuous columns, value frequencies, rating aggregates, and target mean and count lookups from the original dataset.
- The original 129,880-row dataset is appended to every training fold, never to validation.
- One extra feature is the probability from a CatBoost trained only on the original data (out-of-fold on the original rows).
- depth 8, l2_leaf_reg 4, learning rate 0.03, early stopping 400, GPU.

## Split and scores

`StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)` on the competition train in its original row order. This is the split most public OOF stacks for this episode use, so the arrays line up with them.

| | AUC |
|---|---|
| CV (OOF) | 0.96067 |
| Folds | 0.96084, 0.95979, 0.96129, 0.96075, 0.96071 |
| Public LB | 0.96000 |

## Files

- **oof_cb_cat.npy**: float64 array, one probability per train row, in train.csv order.
- **test_cb_cat.npy**: float64 array, one probability per test row, in test.csv order (mean of the 5 fold models).
- **submission.csv**: ready-to-submit file built from the test predictions.
- **catboost_info/**: CatBoost training logs of the last fold.

## Usage

```python
import glob
import numpy as np

oof = np.load(glob.glob('/kaggle/input/**/oof_cb_cat.npy', recursive=True)[0])
test = np.load(glob.glob('/kaggle/input/**/test_cb_cat.npy', recursive=True)[0])
```

Full example with a LightGBM blend: [S6E10 | CatBoost OOF + fast LightGBM rank blend](https://www.kaggle.com/code/dmitriykolmikov/s6e10-catboost-oof-fast-lightgbm-rank-blend)

Upvote if it helps your blend.
